mapper.select: select S.STUDENT_NO ,S.NAME as NAME ,S.GRADE ,S.SEMESTER ,S.TRACK ,S.STATUS ,SCH.SCHOOL_CODE ,SCH.NAME as SCHOOL_NAME ,T.MAJOR ,T.UNIV ,T.RANKING ,CON.CONSULTANT_NO ,ORG.NAME as CONSULTANT_ORG_NAME ,M.NICKNAME as CONSULTANT_NICKNAME from STUDENT S left join SCHOOL SCH on (S.SCHOOL_CODE = SCH.SCHOOL_CODE) left join TARGET_INFO T on (S.STUDENT_NO = T.STUDENT_NO) left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS on (CS.STUDENT_NO = S.STUDENT_NO) left join CONSULTANT CON on (CON.CONSULTANT_NO = CS.CONSULTANT_NO) left join CONSULTANT_ORG ORG on (ORG.ORG_NO = CON.ORG_NO) left join MEMBER M on (M.MEMBER_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO) where S.STUDENT_NO = #{studentNo} order by T.RANKING ASC

select S.STUDENT_NO ,S.NAME ,S.GRADE ,S.SEMESTER ,S.TRACK ,SCH.NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME ,T.MAJOR ,T.UNIV ,T.RANKING from STUDENT S left join TARGET_INFO T on (S.STUDENT_NO = T.STUDENT_NO) left join SCHOOL SCH on (SCH.SCHOOL_CODE = S.SCHOOL_CODE) where S.STUDENT_NO = #{studentNo} and S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' order by T.RANKING ASC

select C.STUDENT_NO ,C.NAME ,C.GRADE ,C.SEMESTER ,C.TRACK ,C.SCHOOL_NAME ,C.CONSULTANT_NICKNAME ,C.CONSULTANT_ORG_NAME ,T.MAJOR ,T.UNIV ,T.RANKING from( select B.* from( select ROWNUM AS RN, A.* from( select S.STUDENT_NO ,S.NAME ,S.GRADE ,S.SEMESTER ,S.TRACK ,SCH.NAME as SCHOOL_NAME ,M.NICKNAME as CONSULTANT_NICKNAME ,CON_ORG.NAME as CONSULTANT_ORG_NAME from STUDENT S left join SCHOOL SCH on (S.SCHOOL_CODE = SCH.SCHOOL_CODE) left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS on (CS.STUDENT_NO = S.STUDENT_NO) left join CONSULTANT CON on (CON.CONSULTANT_NO = CS.CONSULTANT_NO) left join CONSULTANT_ORG CON_ORG on (CON_ORG.ORG_NO = CON.ORG_NO) left join MEMBER M on (M.MEMBER_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO)
and S.NAME like '%' || #{name} || '%' escape '/'
and S.GRADE = #{grade}
and S.SEMESTER = #{semester}
and S.TRACK like '%' || #{track} || '%' escape '/'
and SCH.NAME like '%' || #{schoolName} || '%' escape '/'
and exists( select 1 from TARGET_INFO T2 inner join STUDENT S2 on(T2.STUDENT_NO = S2.STUDENT_NO) where S2.STUDENT_NO = S.STUDENT_NO
and T2.UNIV like '%' || #{targetUniv} || '%' escape '/'
and T2.MAJOR like '%' || #{targetMajor} || '%' escape '/'
)
and exists
and not exists
( select 1 from CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS3 where CS3.STUDENT_NO = S.STUDENT_NO )
and M.NICKNAME like '%' || #{consultantNickname} || '%' escape '/'
and CON_ORG.NAME like '%' || #{consultantOrgName} || '%' escape '/'
order by S.STUDENT_NO DESC ) A where ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) B where B.RN >= #{startRow} ) C left join TARGET_INFO T on(T.STUDENT_NO = C.STUDENT_NO) order by C.RN ASC, T.RANKING ASC

select count(distinct S.STUDENT_NO) from STUDENT S left join SCHOOL SCH on (S.SCHOOL_CODE = SCH.SCHOOL_CODE)
left join TARGET_INFO T on(T.STUDENT_NO = S.STUDENT_NO)
left join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS on (CS.STUDENT_NO = S.STUDENT_NO) left join CONSULTANT CON on (CON.CONSULTANT_NO = CS.CONSULTANT_NO) left join CONSULTANT_ORG CON_ORG on (CON_ORG.ORG_NO = CON.ORG_NO) left join MEMBER M on (M.MEMBER_NO = CON.CONSULTANT_NO)
and S.NAME = like '%' || #{name} || '%'
and S.GRADE = #{grade}
and S.SEMESTER = #{semester}
and S.TRACK like '%' || #{track} || '%'
and SCH.NAME like '%' || #{schoolName} || '%'
and T.UNIV like '%' || #{targetUniv} || '%'
and T.MAJOR like '%' || #{targetMajor} || '%'
and exists
and not exists
( select 1 from CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS3 where CS3.STUDENT_NO = S.STUDENT_NO )
and M.NICKNAME like '%' || #{consultantNickname} || '%'
and CON_ORG.NAME like '%' || #{consultantOrgName} || '%'

select STU.STUDENT_NO ,STU.NAME ,STU.GRADE ,STU.SEMESTER ,STU.TRACK ,SCH.NAME as SCHOOL_NAME ,TI.RANKING ,TI.UNIV ,TI.MAJOR from STUDENT STU inner join CONSULTANT_STUDENT CS on (CS.STUDENT_NO = STU.STUDENT_NO) inner join SCHOOL SCH on (SCH.SCHOOL_CODE = STU.SCHOOL_CODE) inner join TARGET_INFO TI on (TI.STUDENT_NO = STU.STUDENT_NO) where CS.CONSULTANT_NO = #{consultantNo} order by STU.STUDENT_NO desc, TI.RANKING asc
